items: We start from your use-case inventory — even a rough list — and score it against value-density and data-readiness criteria before the first workshop.
Six weeks, structured: Value Mapping workshops with your domain owners, scored use-case portfolio, and a sequenced delivery plan priced from evidence.
A two-page readout with the reasoning attached — the scored portfolio, the sequence we would run, and the baseline window to lock first.
Your domain owners plus one decision maker with budget context — the scoring only works when the people who own the workflows are in the room.
The use-case backlog, however messy, and access to whoever can speak to data readiness for the top candidates.
The sprint is fixed-fee and scoped before it starts; most clients treat it as the entry gate to their first delivery quarter.
